title: Sprint stability pulse and hotfix cadence
content:
Meeting: Sprint stability pulse and hotfix cadence
Date: 2025-02-13 10:00 PT
Attendees: Ava (chair), Marco, Priya, Jordan, Elena, SRE rotation (Maya)
Purpose: Weekly alignment on upcoming release train windows, hotfix readiness, and change log reconciliation. Goal is to reduce mid-window thrash and clarify rollback criteria for the new timeout/kv-cache change.

1) Quick status snapshot (3–5 minutes each)
- Serving-runtime: Marco — kernel selection patch (KR-957) landed to canary; perf looks +8% p50 on 8k seqs but +12% token variance under burst. Observed rare memory spike on replica b during load test.
- Release infra: Priya — change window schedule stable; we have two conflicting deploys in week 9 (feature A and security patch). Proposing small reorder or carve-out hotfix slot.
- Console & rollouts: Jordan — rollout API supports change annotations now; enabling automatic canary hold on error rates. Need final wording for auto-fallback message.
- SRE / oncall: Maya — no pager incidents this sprint but still seeing increased deploy-time latency for autoscale events. Collecting traces.

2) Hotfix triage (items flagged since last pulse)
- HF-21: kv-cache regression (reported 2025-02-11) — Symptoms: cache miss rate spike causing 20–30% p99 latency regressions on long-tail tenants. Owner: Marco. Action: revert patch on non-prod, run targeted synthetic. Decision: patch pinned to canary; do not promote until regression root cause identified. Target follow-up: postmortem draft by 2025-02-15.
- HF-22: auth token expiry mismatch (customer report) — Owner: Priya. Fix staged; emergency deploy scheduled 2025-02-14 03:00 UTC in a short hotfix window. Notify affected tenants.

3) Release train window planning (week 9–10)
- Proposal: Reserve Tuesday 09:00–11:00 PT for major releases; Friday 02:00–04:00 PT for small-risk changes/hotfixes. This gives at least 48h separation for rollback and monitoring.
- Conflict: Feature A (requires schema migration) currently slated for Friday slot; security patch needs urgent Friday slot. Action: move Feature A to Tuesday and run migration in a maintenance-capped canary (10% traffic). Owner: Priya to coordinate with product.
- Canary policy tweak: for database/schema migrations, require 72h canary and run read-only shadow for first 24h. Add checklist item to rollout template. Owner: Jordan.

4) Change log reconciliation and documentation hygiene
- Outstanding: 9 PRs merged without change-annotations (found by script). Need author follow-ups. Action: automation to block merge without annotation by March. Owner: Marco + infra team.
- Release notes cadence: agreed to publish an internal change digest on Monday after deploys and a public changelog on Friday. Owner: Elena to draft initial template.

5) Rollback and fallback playbooks (clarify for new kv-cache behavior)
- Immediate fallback plan: if p99 token latency exceeds baseline +25% for >15m, trigger automatic downgrade to previous runtime build and route traffic to fallback region.
- Owners: SRE (Maya) to own traffic routing, Serving team (Marco) to own binary rollback.
- Checkpoints: preflight smoke + synthetic with long-tail tenants, and canary-scale at 10% traffic for 2h before further ramp.

6) Observability and telemetry asks
- New dashboards: add p50/p95/p99 token-latency breakdown by tenant weight class and by model variant. Owner: Jordan. Target: 2025-02-20.
- Alert refinement: create a dedicated kv-cache alert that watches miss-rate delta and a composite alert that only fires on matching traffic surge + miss-rate (reduce false positives). Owner: Maya.

7) Post-deploy verification checklist (short, to be added into rollout template)
- Smoke test: health endpoints across replicas (vitals ok)
- Synthetics: run 15m long-tail synthetic using 90th percentile prompt shapes
- Cost check: observe token-per-second delta for first 30m
- Error ramp guard: if errors/latency exceed threshold, hold and rollback
- Stakeholder tick: email to affected customer contacts if rollback occurs

8) Open risks / decisions required
- Risk R1: Two high-risk changes in same week (feature A + security patch) — decision required by 2025-02-14 on reorder.
- Risk R2: Autoscale latency spikes during deploys — SRE investigating whether a pre-warm strategy reduces event storm.
- Decision D1: Enable automated merge-block for missing change-annotations by 2025-03-01. 

9) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Marco: Root cause investigation for HF-21 kv-cache regression; create postmortem draft (2025-02-15).
- Priya: Coordinate Feature A reschedule and confirm schema migration plan (2025-02-14).
- Jordan: Add rollback checklist to rollout API and create new latency dashboards (2025-02-20).
- Maya: Implement kv-cache composite alert and run pre-warm experiment for autoscale (2025-02-18).
- Elena: Draft public/internal changelog templates and publish first internal digest (2025-02-17).

10) Quick notes / scratchpad (informal, not approved)
- Idea: run a weekly "hotfix micro-window" mid-week for 30m for trivial fixes that are low risk (ex: cert bump). Keep list of allowed micro-fixes.
- Question for security: are we comfortable with 24h public disclosure for non-critical deploys? (tagging security team offline)

Next meeting: 2025-02-20 10:00 PT (same channel)

Appendix: Recent deploy timeline (last 2 weeks)
- 2025-02-03: rollout-runtime-1.4.2 — canaries OK, minor telemetry drift, no customer impact.
- 2025-02-08: console-rollout-0.9.1 — small UI regression, rolled back in 40m.
- 2025-02-11: kv-cache-kernel-optim — pinned on canary due to HF-21.

Notes on collaboration: link PRs in linked_artifacts above; add any urgent flags to the release-engineering Slack channel with prefix [RELEASE-URGENT].

End of notes.
